usedFor: Eventzilla holds your registrations and Google Docs keeps the roster, so “New Registration” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each registration is added to a doc tab as it happens, so the attendee list stays current.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace the tab's content, so set it to add before you run it.
